subject.title: Gateway Dashboard chat buttons lose busy state after tab switch and can interrupt active runs

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41067, ask the contributor to rebase and prove it, or keep the paired issue paused until another current-main PR owns the fix?
rationale: The bug is valid and paired with an open closing PR, but the remaining choice crosses current UI/Gateway lifecycle ownership and live-proof expectations that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite or adoption can preserve the recovery intent while using the current active-run and protocol contracts.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase and prove
options.body: The contributor can update the existing branch against current main and add redacted live Dashboard tab-return proof before another review.

options.title: Pause until a replacement is viable
options.body: If a newer proof-positive PR becomes the safe fix path, keep this issue linked until that replacement lands or clearly supersedes the old branch.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
recommendation.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite or adoption can preserve the recovery intent while using the current active-run and protocol contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent commits own the current refactored UI/Gateway active-run paths that any safe replacement would need to touch.
